title: Warm, Peppery Middle-Eastern Cauliflower Ouzi
description: A warm and flavorful Middle-Eastern-inspired dish featuring roasted cauliflower, crunchy pine nuts, and fragrant spices. Great for meal prep and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse the cauliflower and remove the leaves and stem. Cut it into florets and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cauliflower and sprinkle with cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Toss to coat.
Roast the cauliflower in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
While the cauliflower is roasting, toast the pine nuts in a small skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
In a blender or food processor, combine the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and 1 tablespoon of water. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted cauliflower, tahini sauce, and toasted pine nuts. Toss to coat.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.
For meal prep, prepare the cauliflower and tahini sauce in advance and assemble the dish just before serving.
